# Crossio: Custom Crosshair

Crossio is an Android utility for choosing, customizing, locally importing, and displaying a crosshair as a visual overlay.

## Verified behavior

- The main crosshair overlay is passive and click-through; it cannot receive touch or key input.
- An optional, separate mini control overlay is touchable so the user can manage visibility and position.
- The app does not access another app's code, memory, files, data, or network traffic.
- The app provides no auto-aim, auto-tap, macros, input injection, or game automation.
- Users start the overlay from the app and can stop the foreground service from its persistent notification.
- Optional auto-start may restart the selected overlay when Crossio is opened.
- Battery-optimization exemption is optional and managed in Android settings.

## Data and services

Crossio uses Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Cloud Messaging, anonymous authentication and Firestore; Google Mobile Ads; RevenueCat; and Google Play Billing. Imported crosshair images remain in local app storage and are not uploaded to flappsio servers for the import feature. Crosshair names, full definitions, and local file paths are not sent to Firebase Analytics. Categorical engagement attributes may be sent to RevenueCat for subscription-offer targeting.

## Important limitation

Some games and competitive platforms may restrict visual overlays. Users must check the current rules of each third-party service. Crossio does not guarantee that a third party permits overlay use or that an account will not be restricted.
